verdict.rationale: Open-protocol access and standards-based export are a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Superhuman working on top of Gmail and Outlook accounts ('Built for teams that use Gmail or Outlook'). Nothing documents IMAP, JMAP or SMTP support, or any mbox/EML export from Superhuman itself. Any open-protocol reachability would come from the underlying providers, which is a host-platform capability, and the proprietary MCP connector is a different feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
